C1719: Cortech Tray Master Non-Insulated Food Tray Delivery Cart
Product URL: https://www.anchortex.com/products/cortech-c1719-the-tray-master-food-delivery-cart
Manufacturer page: https://cortechusa.com/products/food-service/correctional-food-tray-delivery-carts/tray-master/
Spec sheet: C1719
Recommended H1 and Subtitle
H1: Cortech Tray Master Non-Insulated Food Tray Delivery Cart – C1719
Current H1: Cortech Tray Master Food Delivery Cart - C1719
Subtitle: One-Piece Molded Tray Cart That Holds Up to 156 Rock Trays, with 90° Dual-Lock Doors
Current subtitle: Cortech USA C1719
Revised Product Description
Headings marked [H2] should be set as H2 on the page.
The Cortech Tray Master Non-Insulated Food Tray Delivery Cart carries stacked meal trays from the kitchen to housing units in prisons, jails, and other correctional facilities. It holds up to 156 Rock Trays, 114 Rock 2.0 Trays, or 108 X-Trays, which removes the need for tray straps.
The cart is rotationally molded in one piece from high impact “no break” polyethylene, with no seams, welded walls, adhesives, or mechanically attached walls. Its 90° Dual-Lock doors lock open for loading and lock closed for transport.
Material: One-piece rotationally molded high impact “no break” polyethylene
Construction: No seams, no welded walls, no adhesives, and no mechanically attached walls
Dimensions: 67”L×32”W×54”H
Weight: 240 lbs
Tray Size: Holds any tray up to 9½”×14½”
Tray Capacity: 156 Rock Trays, 114 Rock 2.0 Trays, or 108 X-Trays; trays sold separately
Doors: 90° Dual-Lock doors lock open for loading and unloading and lock closed for transport
Top Surface: Raised top edge safely holds more trays, beverage servers, and wash racks
Handles: Handle slots for easy navigation
Casters: Non-marring kingpin-less casters
Finish: Smooth finish reduces marring of wall surfaces
Insulation: Non-insulated
Color: Brown (custom colors available on request)
Warranty: 3-year factory warranty
Country of Manufacture: USA, made to ISO quality standards
Available Models and Options
C1719 – Tray Master: Non-insulated food tray delivery cart
Installation and Options
No assembly is required.
[H2] Applications
The Tray Master suits facilities that move large numbers of stacked trays and do not need an insulated cart.
Typical applications include:
Meal delivery from central kitchens to housing units in prisons and jails
Detention centers and juvenile facilities
Other secure facilities that deliver meals on trays
Explore Anchortex's Prison and Detention Kitchen and Food Service Equipment collection for more food trays, delivery carts, and food service supplies.
[H2] About Cortech Food Service
Cortech food service products are made for high-volume meal service in correctional facilities, where trays, carts, and dispensers are used and washed every day. Cortech trays and delivery carts are sized to work together.
Cortech food service includes:
Insulated Food Trays: The Rock, Rock 2.0, Rock with Cor-Flex, and X-Tray, with matching lids
Tray Delivery Carts: The insulated Chuckwagon, Chuckwagon Jr., and Chuckwagon Max, and the non-insulated Tray Master
Beverage Service: The BevMax insulated beverage dispenser
Tray Drying: Aluminum meal tray drying racks
[H2] About Cortech
Cortech manufactures durable molded furniture for demanding environments, including behavioral healthcare facilities, psychiatric hospitals, correctional institutions, law enforcement facilities, and homeless and emergency shelters. Explore the full line of Cortech Behavioral Health and Prison Furniture at Anchortex.
Meta Title and Description
Meta title (64 characters): Cortech Tray Master Food Tray Delivery Cart - C1719 at Anchortex
Meta description (140 characters): Shop the Cortech Tray Master. A one-piece molded non-insulated tray delivery cart that holds up to 156 Rock Trays, with 90° Dual-Lock doors.
Notes and Questions
Series section: "About Cortech Food Service" is a new section for the food service pages (trays, lids, delivery carts, BevMax, and drying racks). It is the same on each of these pages.
H1: Cortech calls it the Tray Master Non-Insulated Food Tray Delivery Cart, so I used that.
Weight: your variant is set to 245 lbs. The Cortech spec sheet says 240 lbs, so I used 240 lbs.
Load capacity: the Cortech spec sheet lists the C1719 as "Insulated Cart (Capacity 1000 Lbs)," but the rest of the sheet says it is non-insulated. That line looks copied from the Chuckwagon sheet, so I left out the load capacity.
Warranty: your current page does not list a warranty. The Cortech spec sheet says 3-year factory warranty, so I added it.
I left out "eliminate maintenance costs" and "the most versatile," since these are marketing claims.
Collection link: I linked the Prison and Detention Kitchen and Food Service Equipment collection, which this product is already in.
Product images: the page has one image. The Cortech product page has a photo of the Tray Master with its doors open. Would you like me to add it?
